lineage.strategy: Add capital-light infrastructure-partner economics distinct from hyperscaler contracts and channel partnership evidence.

observations.fact: Nebius introduced an infrastructure-partnership model in which partners finance and own infrastructure and hardware while Nebius supplies architecture, supply-chain access, hardware design, software/services and go-to-market capacity.

Nebius describes the model as a route to expand global AI-cloud capacity with minimal incremental capital requirements and a high-margin revenue stream, while retaining customer commercialization through its sales organization.

risks.risk: The announced model is a business architecture, not evidence of realized partner economics, deployment volumes, margin contribution or customer utilization; issuer characterization of high margins remains forward-looking until reported results exist.

unknowns.unknown: Named infrastructure partners, contracted megawatts, revenue-sharing terms, realized margins and time-to-capacity under this model are not disclosed in the announcement.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed evidence of a potentially less capital-intensive scaling path, but do not score claimed high-margin economics as realized until contracts/results substantiate them.
